div.p: Welcome to the Baseline Framework Application. This toolkit provides comprehensive guidance, tools, and dashboards for establishing effective baselines in your environment.

html.p: Baselining is the process of establishing normal patterns of behavior in your network and host environments. This framework helps you implement effective baselines to identify anomalies, potential threats, and unauthorized activities.

search.query: | makeresults count=7 | streamstats count | eval category=case( count==1, "Network Traffic Baselines", count==2, "Host Process Baselines", count==3, "User Behavior Baselines", count==4, "Application Baselines", count==5, "DNS Query Baselines", count==6, "Authentication Baselines", count==7, "Connection Baselines" ) | eval status=case( count==1, "Active", count==2, "Active", count==3, "Active", count==4, "Pending", count==5, "Active", count==6, "Active", count==7, "Pending" ) | eval last_updated=case( count==1, relative_time(now(), "-2h"), count==2, relative_time(now(), "-6h"), count==3, relative_time(now(), "-12h"), count==4, relative_time(now(), "-2d"), count==5, relative_time(now(), "-1d"), count==6, relative_time(now(), "-4h"), count==7, relative_time(now(), "-3d") ) | eval value=case( count==1, 95, count==2, 87, count==3, 90, count==4, 0, count==5, 92, count==6, 88, count==7, 0 ) | table category, status, value, last_updated | where status="Active" | sort - value

ol.li: Understand the Framework - Review the Operational Framework dashboard to understand the baselining concepts and methodology.
Network Baselining - Use the Network Baseline Components and Zeek guides to establish network behavior baselines.
Host Baselining - Follow the Host Baseline Components guide to establish normal behavior patterns on your endpoints.
Alert Configuration - Use the Alert from Baseline Lookups methods to identify anomalies against your established baselines.
Continuous Improvement - Regularly update and refine your baselines as your environment evolves.
